fredparker.title: Fred Parker Whole-Home Remodel & Exterior Envelope Overhaul
fredparker.lead: Full exterior envelope renovation: tear-off down to original sheathing, thermal vapor wrap, window pan flashing, slate blue vinyl lap siding, custom brake metal casing wraps, and architectural white gable accents.

slides.title: Phase 1: Full Exterior Tear-Off & Sheathing Inspection
slides.caption: Complete removal of aged siding down to substrate, verifying structural OSB sheathing and stud condition across all exterior elevations.

slides.title: Phase 2: Continuous Vapor Barrier & Seam Taping
slides.caption: Installation of high-performance weather-resistant barrier (WRB) with shingle-lapped vertical seams and acrylic flashing tape.

slides.title: Phase 3: Window Sill Pan Flashing & Thermal Break
slides.caption: Precision sill pan flashing, expanding low-pressure foam insulation around window rough openings, and drip cap head flashing.

slides.title: Phase 4: Laser-Leveled Starter Strip & Outside Corner Posts
slides.caption: Precision laser transit baseline layout for starter strips and 3-1/2 inch architectural white vinyl corner post assemblies.

slides.title: Phase 5: Slate Blue Vinyl Lap Siding Installation
slides.caption: Installation of premium thick-gauge vinyl lap siding with 1/4-inch thermal expansion allowance in all receiving J-channels.

slides.title: Phase 6: Custom Brake Metal Window & Door Casing Wraps
slides.caption: On-site custom aluminum sheet metal bending on 10-foot brake, encasing exterior window frames with clean hemmed returns.

slides.title: Phase 7: Continuous Vented Soffits & Aluminum Fascia
slides.caption: Under-eave intake soffit ventilation integration and matching heavy-gauge aluminum fascia wraps protecting wood rafter tails.

slides.title: Phase 8: Architectural White Gable Accents & Completed Elevation
slides.caption: Upper gable transition board flashing, crisp white accent trim, and full exterior perimeter weather seal inspection.

dickman.title: Dickman Residential Addition & Heavy Structural Framing
dickman.lead: Wisconsin Rapids home addition (JOB-DICKMAN-003): ground-up framing, treated mudsills, 2x10 floor joists 16" O.C., 2x6 exterior load-bearing walls, engineered roof truss tie-ins, and shear wall sheathing.

slides.title: Stage 1: Excavation, Staging & Foundation Anchor Layout
slides.caption: Driveway jobsite staging, lumber grading inspection, and foundation sill plate anchor bolt layout for addition tie-in.

slides.title: Stage 2: Treated Mudsill & 2x10 Subfloor Joist Assembly
slides.caption: Pressure-treated sill gaskets, 2x10 floor joists on 16" centers, cross-bridging, and tongue-and-groove subfloor glue/screw fastening.

slides.title: Stage 3: 2x6 Exterior Wall Framing & Double Headers
slides.caption: 2x6 framing for superior R-value insulation cavity, structural double top plates, engineered window headers, and corner corner-posts.

slides.title: Stage 4: Structural Roof Truss Placement & Ridge Tie-Ins
slides.caption: Setting engineered common and scissor trusses, temporary bracing, hurricane tie anchoring, and existing roof valley tie-in.

slides.title: Stage 5: 7/16" OSB Shear Wall Sheathing & Weather Wrap
slides.caption: 7/16" structural OSB wall and roof sheathing with 8d ring-shank nailing pattern, followed by complete weather-tight building wrap.

scholz.title: Scholz Living Room Level-5 Drywall & Interior Trim Remodel
scholz.lead: Living room craftsmanship overhaul: heavy floor protection, laser wall leveling, multi-coat corner bead compound float, PVA high-build primer, and satin urethane enamel trim.

slides.title: Step 1: Floor Masking & Laser Alignment
slides.caption: Ram Board floor protection, containment barriers, and laser leveling of uneven wall stud transitions before compounding.

slides.title: Step 2: Paper-Faced Corner Bead Float
slides.caption: Setting paper-faced metal corner beads and applying first coat of lightweight joint compound feathered out 8 inches.

slides.title: Step 3: Ceiling Feathering & Dustless Sanding
slides.caption: Multi-coat joint compound blending on ceiling seams with HEPA vacuum dustless sanding for level-5 surface uniformity.

slides.title: Step 4: High-Build PVA Primer Application
slides.caption: Airless spray application of high-solids PVA drywall primer to equalize porosity between drywall paper and joint compound.

slides.title: Step 5: Enamel Window & Door Trim Casing
slides.caption: Precision 45-degree mitered door and window casings finished with durable satin urethane enamel.

slides.title: Step 6: Completed Living Room Architectural Trim
slides.caption: Pristine finished space with clean baseboards, casing returns, and seamless level-5 wall surfaces ready for furniture placement.

siding.title: Two-Story Slate Blue Siding & Architectural White Gables
siding.lead: Multi-story exterior transformation with foil-faced thermal barrier, slate blue lap siding, and vented vinyl soffits.

slides.title: Phase 1: Finished Slate Blue Siding & Corner Trims
slides.caption: Completed multi-story exterior showing crisp white corner posts and uniform lap siding lines.

slides.title: Phase 2: High-Elevation Gable Details & Soffit Ventilation
slides.caption: Architectural gable vent framing and continuous hidden-vent soffits ensuring balanced attic airflow.

slides.title: Phase 3: Thermal Barrier & Window Head Flashing
slides.caption: Foil-faced insulation board beneath siding creating a continuous thermal break across exterior wall framing.

decks.title: Custom Composite Deck & Heavy Timber Substructure
decks.lead: Below-frost concrete sonotube footings, treated 2x10 joist framing, tongue-and-groove pine ceiling, and premium composite decking with hidden fasteners.

slides.title: Stage 1: Finished Composite Surface & Rail Package
slides.caption: Maintenance-free grooved composite deck boards installed with hidden clip fasteners and code-compliant railing.

slides.title: Stage 2: Heavy Timber Joist Framing & Structural Posts
slides.caption: Treated 2x10 joist framing, galvanized post-to-beam connectors, and solid timber ledger board attachment with code lag screws.

slides.title: Stage 3: Tongue-and-Groove Pine Porch Ceiling
slides.caption: Natural knotty pine tongue-and-groove ceiling with clear spar urethane finish installed beneath covered deck.

windows.title: Replacement Windows & Insulated Entry Doors
windows.lead: Energy-efficient Low-E Argon vinyl replacement windows with expanding foam air-seals and custom exterior brake metal casing wraps.

slides.title: Stage 1: Low-Pressure Foam Insulation Seal
slides.caption: Expanding closed-cell low-pressure polyurethane foam creating an airtight draft barrier without bowing the window jambs.

slides.title: Stage 2: Custom Aluminum Casing Wrap & Silicone Seal
slides.caption: Exterior wood brickmould fully wrapped with heavy aluminum trim coil and sealed with commercial neutral-cure silicone.
